mcqs.question: For the Axiom-4 mission carrying Shubhanshu Shukla to the International Space Station, when was docking targeted?
mcqs.explanation: Docking of the Axiom-4 mission was targeted for 26 June 2025 at 4:30 PM IST, after a 28-hour journey. The tempting alternative of 25 June 2025 confuses the docking target with the launch date.
